name: Dragon Shire
theme: Control both Shrines simultaneously to awaken and pilot the devastating Dragon Knight.
firstObjective: Shrines activate at 1:30 (reactivate 1:30–2:00 after the Dragon Knight expires or is defeated)
spawnPattern: Fixed locations: Sun Shrine (Top), Dragon Statue (Mid), and Moon Shrine (Bottom)

mechanic.title: Sun & Moon Shrines / Dragon Knight
mechanic.description: Capturing a Shrine takes 4 seconds when neutral (or 8 seconds if held by the enemy team). Once your team controls both the Sun and Moon Shrines at the same time, an allied Hero can channel the Dragon Statue in mid lane for 3 seconds to summon and pilot the Dragon Knight—an Unstoppable vehicle with Flame Breath, Savage Charge, and Rubble Maker structure bonus damage and damage reduction.

camps.name: Siege Giants (3 Camps)
camps.notes: Located near the side/bottom areas. Long-range siege mercenaries; time them ahead of Shrine pushes so lane pressure forces enemies to split.

camps.name: Bruisers / Knights (2 Camps)
camps.notes: Located in the upper/side jungle paths. Durable melee knights that push lanes and apply pressure opposite an active Shrine contest.

strategy: Dragon Shire revolves around split-map rotations, 1v1 solo-lane stability, and Shrine timing rather than random objective spawns. Run a reliable solo laner to contest or hold a side lane while rotating to secure Shrines and clear camps ahead of objective pushes so defenders cannot easily answer both.
notes: The piloted Dragon Knight's duration scales up with elapsed match time, and its knockback/charge can also be used to peel or displace enemies—avoid charging into tight gates or enemy backlines without backup, and watch your Shrine control before channeling the statue.
